mechanism: The validator waited for the first insurer card to be CSS-visible and geometrically stable.
Playwright locator visibility does not require the element center to be inside the viewport.
The replacement semantic click used document.elementFromPoint at the card center without first scrolling the card into view.
elementFromPoint can return null or another element when the center is outside the viewport, producing centerHit=false before any click is dispatched.

The original Playwright click automatically scrolls elements into view; validator revision 20260730.5 unintentionally removed that precondition while trying to avoid Playwright actionability false negatives.

requiredBehavior: scroll target card into the center of the viewport
wait for geometry to settle after scrolling
prove center coordinates are inside viewport bounds
prove elementFromPoint resolves to the card or a descendant
record sanitized hit-test diagnostics on failure
dispatch the canonical DOM click only after these preconditions pass
